title: Minimum-Cost Intervention Design at the First Nontrivial Residual-Hedge Rank in Bow-Free ADMGs
banked_reason: Latest normalized D0.5.G: paper_score_ceiling 6.8 < 7.2 field bar; math and decision panels pass, but no faithful same-scope material repair exists.

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the rank-three hedge classification, private-guard realization, objective-preserving hardness, weighted factor-two rounding, and exact LP-gap frontier, and both mathematical and decision reviews passed. Formalization exposed and repaired the missing vertex-order, complexity-model, and positive-cost dependency edges; the final normalized novelty review nevertheless capped the sound package at subfield because promise recognition remains open, tightness is UGC-conditional on a narrower subclass, the identification bridge is imported, and no solver benchmarks were delivered.
tldr: Under the standard positive-compatible recursive semi-Markovian semantics, acquiring \(Q[V\setminus A]=P(V\setminus A\mid\operatorname{do}(A))\) identifies the causal target \(Q_s\) exactly when \(A\) hits every minimal residual hedge. Rank three is the first nonzero minimal residual-hedge rank for finite simple bow-free singleton-target ADMGs, and four-vertex hedges are exactly complementary directed and bidirected spanning paths. A one-private-guard expansion, oriented by a source-vertex order \(\prec\) on \(U\), realizes the edge clutter of every finite simple graph, yielding unit-cost \(\mathsf{NP}\)- and \(\mathsf{APX}\)-hardness on radius-two bidirected trees. Under the promise \(r(G,s)\leq3\), the path classification partitions every minimal residual across target parents and spouses; after polynomial enumeration in the lexicographic order induced by an independently supplied causal-vertex order \(\triangleleft_V\) on \(V\), this yields a deterministic weighted factor-two LP rounding algorithm. Consequently, the weighted natural-covering-LP integrality-gap supremum over all positive-rational-cost instances in the promised class with nonempty residual clutter is exactly two; unit-cost complete-graph expansions witness the lower bound, and the Khot--Regev threshold transfers under \(\mathsf{UGC}\) on the narrower unit-cost radius-two-tree subclass. The supplied-order promised enumerator and optimizer-or-rank-violation interface support existing exact solvers without claiming an unrestricted rank-three recognition algorithm.
gap: The published MCID frontier jumps from polynomial solvability at residual size two to unrestricted logarithmic hardness. It does not identify the first nonempty bow-free singleton rank or its causal-specific approximation ratio.
fill: The paper proves the exact four-vertex obstruction classification and representation theorem, transfers objective-preserving hardness, derives a tight factor-two LP frontier, and gives a certifying interface that is useful without asserting an unrestricted rank recognizer.
